events.verdict: Ellis (SAC) places a hand on LaVine's (CHI) body and immediately removes it as he enters his shooting motion.
Giddey (CHI) jumps forwards into Fox (SAC), initiating body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Williams (CHI) establishes himself in Murray's (SAC) path and is firming up as they come together during the pick.
DeRozan (SAC) moves laterally into LaVine (CHI), initiating body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Fox (SAC) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Vucevic (CHI).

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: The ball goes off of Vucevic's (CHI) leg before it goes out of bounds.
DeRozan (CHI) leans into Williams (CHI) before stepping back and the contact is marginal.
Sabonis (SAC) has both hands placed on Vucevic's (CHI) back during the rebound and he releases without extension.
Giddey (CHI) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Sabonis's (SAC) possession.

Murray (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position in a straight-line path alongside of LaVine (CHI), who leans into him to create the marginal body contact. Fox (SAC) jumps away from LaVine and avoids making any illegal contact.
Vucevic (CHI) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact initiated by Monk (SAC) during his driving shot attempt.
Giddey (CHI) does not release the throw-in within five seconds.
Vucevic (CHI) commits a take foul on Sabonis (SAC).
Sabonis (SAC) briefly places his hands on LaVine (CHI) before immediately removing them during his driving shot attempt
